spans.s:
डहु m. (-हुः) A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha.)
 E. दह् to burn, affix उ, and
deriv. irr.; also with ऊ affix डहू m. (-हूः).
डाहल m. (-लः) The name of a country; also Tripura: see त्रिपुर.

डाहुक m. (-कः) A gallinule.
 E. दह to consume, (disease,) उकञ् affix,
the flesh being considered medicinal: the radical initial is changed.
